title: Recurrence vector
description: One RFC 5545 expansion case the recurrence adapter must reproduce exactly. The expectation is computed from the tz database by hand, never copied from the recurrence library: a library that disagrees with a vector is the thing under test. `dtstart` is a local date-time in `zone`; `from` and `to` bound the expansion window as UTC instants, inclusive `from`, exclusive `to`. `expect` is the expanded start instants in UTC, ascending. The test globs `*.json` in this directory and skips this schema file by name.

name.description: What this vector proves, in one line.

note.description: How the expectation was computed: the zone's offset before and after the transition, the local times, and why the instant changes or does not change.

zone.description: The IANA zone of the resource the rule is expanded in.

dtstart.description: The first local start, wall-clock in `zone`, without an offset. A value inside a spring-forward gap moves forward by the gap; a value inside a fall-back overlap takes the first occurrence.

rule.description: The recurrence as iCalendar content lines, `RRULE` first and any `EXDATE`/`RDATE` after it, without the trailing CRLF.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound of the expansion window, a UTC instant.

to.description: Exclusive upper bound of the expansion window, a UTC instant.

expect.description: The expanded start instants in UTC, ascending, exactly as the adapter must return them for the window.
